scope: One real device, intercepted synthetic 1401-item fixture, extension absent versus production extension installed. Three warm-up pairs and ten measured pairs; alternating order. Not live-feed or cross-device evidence.

protocol.baseline: Separate browser process with no extension; both isolated contexts remain open, inactive pages blank.
protocol.readyDefinition: Navigation to DOMContentLoaded plus two animation frames, then all 1400 expected collapses when enabled; includes navigation and scheduling.
protocol.cpuDefinition: CDP SystemInfo cumulative process CPU deltas; exited processes unavailable. GPU-process CPU is host CPU time, never GPU utilization.
protocol.memoryDefinition: OS ps resident-set KiB summed by CDP process type at settled checkpoint, not peak/unique physical memory; shared pages may be counted more than once.
protocol.gpuDefinition: GPU utilization and energy unavailable; no dedicated hardware sampler is attached.
protocol.rendererDefinition: CDP Performance renderer TaskDuration/ScriptDuration deltas, including navigation, completion and equal settle time.
